Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP cues, Smart Tab, responsive helpers, and survival tools.
Description: A local PvP HUD with CC prediction and player history, nameplate cues, Limit Break alerts, pressure and CC information, Ping Helpers, medicine-kit beacons, range rings, a Wolves' Den map panel, recovery and job helpers, Smart Tab, assist macros, MP sounds, and target highlights.
Changelog: Fixed Smart Action in CC and Wolves' Den, made held helpers more reliable after key release, added optional BRD Mannstopper, shows CC prediction during preparation, fixed early Guard double-press protection and live opponent LB bars, and repaired the local PvpStats import. Nothing is uploaded. Automated checks are separate from live in-game confirmation.
